# E0228: malformed macro declaration

A procedural macro works on code, not values: it takes `meta.Expr`, `meta.Pattern`, `meta.Type`, `meta.Text`, `meta.File` or a last `meta.Tokens`, and gives a `meta.Expr`, `meta.Pattern` or `meta.Type`.

- Rule: [`macros.procedural-declarations`](../../reference/16-meta.md#macros.procedural-declarations)
- Reported at: the part of the declaration that breaks the rule.
- Tier: `meta`, checked in the `items` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0228:4
use std.meta

/// The number, doubled.
pub macro double(n: i64) -> meta.Expr { quote { $n * 2 } }
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
use std.meta

/// The number, doubled.
pub macro double(n: meta.Expr) -> meta.Expr { quote { $n * 2 } }
```
